scripts.build: npm run build:skeleton && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:skeleton && npm run test:keyframes && npm run test:scoring && npm run test:attempts
scripts.test:keyframes: npm run build:skeleton && tsc -p tsconfig.keyframes.json && node --test tests/keyframes.test.mjs
scripts.test:scoring: npm run build:skeleton && tsc -p tsconfig.keyframes.json && node --test tests/scoring.test.mjs
scripts.test:attempts: npm run build:skeleton && tsc -p tsconfig.keyframes.json && node --test tests/attempts.test.mjs
scripts.replay:attempt: npm run build:skeleton && tsc -p tsconfig.keyframes.json && node scripts/replay-attempt.mjs
